statement: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform reached full production on July 21, 2026, with shipments underway to OpenAI, CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Meta and Dell, compressing the usual 24-30 month cycle into 18 months.
why: A next-generation platform entering volume production earlier than the normal cadence adds accelerator supply and pulls forward the upgrade cycle across cloud buyers.

impact.mechanism: Full production and broad customer shipments increase deliverable accelerator units and pull HBM, packaging and fabric content along with them.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA confirmed that its Vera Rubin AI chip platform reached full production on July 21, 2026, with shipments now underway to major cloud providers and systems manufacturers.
NVIDIA compressed its typical 24-30 month semiconductor cycle into 18 months from Blackwell launch to Rubin production.

confidence.basis: Single secondary trade outlet relaying vendor claims; no primary NVIDIA release in evidence.
